name: adamson/featured-products
title: Featured products
description: Dark full-width product slider: one slide per product line, with a teaser for the next slide.

fields.label: Next label
fields.help: Small label under the next slide's name, top right.

fields.label: Product line name
fields.help: Shown in the previous slide's Next teaser, and instead of the logo if no logo is set.

fields.label: Background word
fields.help: Huge word behind the product, e.g. VERGENCE.

fields.label: Logo
fields.help: Gold-White product logo (SVG or transparent PNG), shown about 42px tall.

fields.label: Background image (optional)
fields.help: Leave empty for the built-in studio backdrop. If the slide has a product cut-out, the background must not contain the product (it moves separately with parallax). Without a cut-out, a full product photo works here.

fields.label: Product image
fields.help: Transparent PNG with the same framing as the background; it sits in front of the background word.

fields.label: Teaser thumbnail
fields.help: Small image shown in the Next teaser on the previous slide.

fields.label: Detail image
fields.help: Close-up shown in the card at the bottom centre. Leave empty and the card is hidden for this slide.

fields.label: Detail link
fields.help: Where the + button on the detail card goes (product page).
